text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Reps got back about five hours a week. Less typing in parking lots, more prepping for the next meeting.

CRM data improved. Fields that used to sit empty now got filled, because summaries did the work.

Customers noticed. Asking permission up front built trust rather than hurting it.

Accuracy wasn't perfect. Product names and pricing needed review, so we kept a quick human check.

Adoption followed managers. Teams whose leads used the summaries in coaching stuck with the tool.

The biggest lesson: the tool didn't change selling. It removed the admin around it.

What is your team seeing with AI note-takers so far?
